name: Acquia CMS Headless
description: Provides functionality for Progressively Decoupled and Purely Headless sites using Node and Next JS.
project_description:
Announcement 
 Acquia CMS has been officially renamed to Acquia Drupal Starter Kit. 

Rest assured, this change does not affect the standards or functionality of the product you know and appreciate. All specifications, features, and support will remain the same.

 Synopsis 
 Acquia Drupal Starter Kit Headless provides shared functionality for the Acquia Drupal Starter Kit ecosystem . This module provides functionality for progressively decoupled and purely headless sites using Node and Next JS and related configuration.

 Getting started 
 To get setup with a full Acquia Drupal Starter Headless Kit installation we recommend following: 

 
 Read the docs on docs.acquia.com 
 See blog post: Start me up: Using starter kits for Next.js and Acquia Drupal Starter Kit
